new_results.statement: For fixed symmetric rank>=3 A and coordinate j, there is finite K(A,j) such that A_m=T_m A T_m has cap-one product output height <=K(A,j)m^(-1/2) for every 0<m<=1.
A cap-one subdensity of mass m in one input coordinate has quadratic pushforward r in C0 with ||r||inf<=K(A,j)sqrt(m).
At fixed rank>=3 A, canonical output densities are 1/2-Holder from each marginal L1 perturbation into output Linfinity; simultaneous marginal changes telescope.

For Q=2XY+Z^2 and explicit cap-one X densities at L1 distance delta, output density distance is >=sqrt(delta)[1-log2-delta/8]; no exponent >1/2 is possible uniformly even for that fixed target matrix.
Cap-preserving mollification converges uniformly at the output-density level for each fixed rank>=3 A; any future universal smooth-input height constant passes to rough cap-one marginals unchanged.

partner_result_actually_applied: account04/B15 r8 Theorem 6.1 applied to P(Y^T A_mY in I)<=K(A,j)m^(-1/2)|I|, yielding normalized p_m in C0 with the same height, then subprobability r_g=m p_m.
